name: Mercure Bangkok Sukhumvit 24
short_description: A 201-room Mercure 100m from BTS Phrom Phong with a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (1,292 reviews), a rooftop pool, and a location minutes from the EmDistrict malls.
ai_summary: Mercure Bangkok Sukhumvit 24 is located only 100 metres from BTS Skytrain Phrom Phong station and a few minutes' walk to the EmDistrict (Emporium and EmQuartier), with Terminal 21 just one BTS stop away. The 201-room property holds a strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 1,292 reviews. Facilities include a contemporary dining restaurant, a rooftop swimming pool, fitness centre, and flexible meeting facilities. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
